suggestions.subtitle: Spotted an editing mistake, visible microphone, or trivia missing from our catalog? Help us make FilmBloopers Hub even more complete.
suggestions.emailDesc: Only used to notify you when your submission is reviewed and to credit hunter points.
suggestions.messagePlaceholder: Include the movie title, exact timestamp (if known), and describe what happens in the scene...
suggestions.rule1: Specify the exact movie title and release year.
suggestions.rule2: Describe the mistake objectively (e.g. object switching hands between cuts).
suggestions.rule3: Include the approximate scene timestamp to speed up verification.
